In [[geometry]], the '''medial pentagonal hexecontahedron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[snub dodecadodecahedron]]. It has 60 intersecting irregular pentagonal faces.

==Proportions==

Denote the [[golden ratio]] by {{mvar|&phi;}}, and let <math>\xi\approx -0.409\,037\,788\,014\,42</math> be the smallest (most negative) real zero of the polynomial <math>P=8x^4-12x^3+5x+1.</math> Then each face has three equal angles of <math>\arccos(\xi)\approx 114.144\,404\,470\,43^{\circ},</math> one of <math>\arccos(\varphi^2\xi+\varphi)\approx 56.827\,663\,280\,94^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>\arccos(\varphi^{-2}\xi-\varphi^{-1})\approx 140.739\,123\,307\,76^{\circ}.</math> Each face has one medium length edge, two short and two long ones. If the medium length is 2, then the short edges have length 
<math display=block>1 + \sqrt{\frac{1-\xi}{\varphi^3-\xi}} \approx 1.550\,761\,427\,20,</math>
and the long edges have length
<math display=block>1 + \sqrt{ \frac{1-\xi}{-\varphi^{-3}-\xi}}\approx 3.854\,145\,870\,08.</math>
The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos\left(\tfrac{\xi}{\xi+1}\right) \approx 133.800\,984\,233\,53^{\circ}.</math> The other real zero of the polynomial {{mvar|P}} plays a similar role for the [[medial inverted pentagonal hexecontahedron]].
